paragraphs.text: Farmers in many countries struggle to find enough workers to pick fruit and vegetables, and a growing number are turning to machines. The most difficult crops to automate are soft fruits such as strawberries, which bruise easily and ripen at different times.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One new robot moves along rows of plants at night, using cameras to identify ripe strawberries by their colour. A soft rubber gripper then twists each fruit gently from the stem. At present the machine picks about a third as fast as an experienced human worker.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Other robots are designed to remove weeds. Instead of spraying chemicals across a whole field, they recognise individual weeds and destroy them with a small burst of electricity, which could greatly reduce the use of herbicides.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The machines are expensive, and many small farms cannot afford them. Some manufacturers have therefore begun to rent robots by the season, so that farmers pay only when the machines are needed.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: which bruise easily and ripen at different times
items.prompt: Strawberries are hard to pick by machine because they bruise easily and 1 ____ at different times.

explanation.en: “which bruise easily and ripen at different times” → ripen. The verb keeps its form: “they … ripen”.
explanation.kk: «which bruise easily and ripen at different times» → ripen. Етістік түрі мәтіндегідей: «they … ripen».
explanation.ru: «which bruise easily and ripen at different times» → ripen. Форма глагола та же, что в тексте: «they … ripen».

items.quote: using cameras to identify ripe strawberries by their colour
items.prompt: The picking robot recognises ripe strawberries by their 2 ____.

explanation.en: “identify ripe strawberries by their colour” → colour (“color” is also accepted). “Recognises” = “identify”.
explanation.kk: «identify ripe strawberries by their colour» → colour (color да есептеледі). «Recognises» = «identify».
explanation.ru: «identify ripe strawberries by their colour» → colour (color тоже засчитывается). «Recognises» = «identify».

items.quote: destroy them with a small burst of electricity
items.prompt: Weeding robots kill weeds with a small burst of 3 ____.

explanation.en: “destroy them with a small burst of electricity” → electricity. “Chemicals” are what the robots replace.
explanation.kk: «destroy them with a small burst of electricity» → electricity. «Chemicals» — роботтар дәл алмастыратын нәрсе.
explanation.ru: «destroy them with a small burst of electricity» → electricity. «Chemicals» — то, что роботы как раз заменяют.

items.quote: which could greatly reduce the use of herbicides
items.prompt: Weeding robots could greatly reduce the use of 4 ____.

explanation.en: “could greatly reduce the use of herbicides” → herbicides, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: «could greatly reduce the use of herbicides» → herbicides, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «could greatly reduce the use of herbicides» → herbicides, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

items.quote: Some manufacturers have therefore begun to rent robots by the season
items.prompt: Some manufacturers allow farmers to 5 ____ robots for a season.

explanation.en: “begun to rent robots by the season” → rent. After “to” we need the base form of the verb.
explanation.kk: «begun to rent robots by the season» → rent. «To» сөзінен кейін етістіктің бастапқы түрі керек.
explanation.ru: «begun to rent robots by the season» → rent. После «to» нужен глагол в начальной форме.
